# ReAlto Partners

> ReAlto Partners is a culture-first group of real estate agents based in Highlands Ranch in the Denver metro area of Colorado, co-founded by Dan and Allison Gomer, who lead it with co-leader Dianne Schell. It is a group within eXp Realty, the brokerage and parent company; Dan and Allison are eXp Realty members, not founders of eXp. Tagline: "Empowering People Through Real Estate." It is a real estate team, not a brokerage (eXp Realty is the brokerage) and not related to any private equity firm named Alto Partners.

Key facts:
- Co-founder and team leader: Dan Gomer, a former middle school science teacher and basketball coach, real estate investor since starting with fix and flips in Denver, in real estate since 2012, and with eXp Realty since 2022.
- Co-founder and podcast co-host: Allison Gomer, Dan's wife and a Realtor with eXp Realty serving buyers and sellers in the Denver metro. Known for a calm, people-first approach and a focus on agent wellbeing and team culture.
- Vision: to redefine success in real estate, creating a world where every agent achieves personal and financial freedom through balance, purpose and collaboration.
- Mission: to empower others through real estate by cultivating a culture built on resiliency, resourcefulness, responsibility and reliability (the 4 R's).
- Co-leader: Dianne Schell, Colorado Springs Realtor with eXp Realty since 2024, formerly a 21-year Senior Vice President at a Fortune 20 company; leads ReAlto's presence in Colorado Springs.
- Core values: culture is our heartbeat; service is the path to success; resourcefulness and resiliency; integrity in all actions; community and dependability.
- Weekly rhythm: Crush the Cap call Wednesdays 9:00 AM Mountain, team call Wednesdays 9:30 AM Mountain.
- Community: free live events, regular team building events, unlimited eXp University trainings, direct access to team leads and managing brokers, masterminds, eXp eXplained luncheons in Denver and Colorado Springs, and a quarterly Cappers dinner.
- Locations: founded in the Denver metro and expanded throughout Colorado's Front Range, with agents in Texas, California, Wisconsin and Minnesota; open to agents anywhere eXp Realty operates (all 50 states and 30+ countries).
- Your brand, your business, on our platform: agents keep their own brand, clients and marketing.
- Phone: 303.261.5278
- Podcast: The Resilient Real Estate Agent, a YouTube video podcast hosted by Dan Gomer with co-host Allison Gomer (https://www.youtube.com/@theresilientrealestateagent). It helps agents beat burnout and build a business that lasts.
- Podcast schedule: new episodes every other Tuesday at 9 a.m. Mountain.
- eXp Realty programs (revenue share, stock awards, splits and caps) are set by eXp Realty and change over time; earnings are not guaranteed.

# Frequently asked questions

## About ReAlto Partners

### What is ReAlto Partners?
ReAlto Partners is a community of real estate agents, co-founded by Dan and Allison Gomer and powered by eXp Realty, the brokerage and parent company. Its mission is to positively impact as many lives as possible through real estate, and its vision is personal and financial freedom for every agent on the team.

### Is ReAlto Partners a real estate brokerage?
No. eXp Realty is the brokerage. ReAlto Partners is an organization of agents inside eXp Realty that adds culture, coaching, training and in-person community on top of eXp's cloud-based platform.

### Who leads ReAlto Partners?
Dan and Allison Gomer founded ReAlto Partners and lead it together with co-leader Dianne Schell. Dan is a former middle school science teacher and basketball coach, a real estate investor and the host of The Resilient Real Estate Agent podcast. Allison is a Realtor, his wife and his co-host on the podcast.

### Where is ReAlto Partners located?
ReAlto Partners was founded in the Denver metro area and has expanded throughout the Front Range. eXp Realty is in all 50 states and more than 30 countries, so we also have agents in Texas, California, Wisconsin and Minnesota. As a cloud-based brokerage, we are happy to talk with agents in all locations.

### Do I keep my own brand and business?
Yes. It is your brand and your business, on our platform. You build your own name with your own clients, and ReAlto Partners and eXp Realty give you the tools, training, support and community to grow it.

### Do I have to give up my clients or my marketing to join?
No. Your clients, your sphere and your marketing stay yours. We help you do more with them through coaching, systems and the people around you.

### Does ReAlto Partners have a podcast?
Yes. The Resilient Real Estate Agent is Dan and Allison Gomer’s video podcast on YouTube. It helps agents beat burnout and build a business that lasts.

### How do I join ReAlto Partners?
Fill out the short form on the Why ReAlto page or call Dan at 303.261.5278. The first step is a no-pressure conversation.

## Joining the team

### Do ReAlto Partners agents ever meet in person?
All the time. Free live events, regular team building events, masterminds, eXp Explained luncheons in Denver and Colorado Springs, and our quarterly Cappers dinner. Cloud based just means we are intentional about it.

### How does support work on eXp's virtual platform?
Agents get fast access to managing brokers through eXp World, eXp's virtual campus, plus direct access to everyone in the ReAlto organization: teachers, former managing brokers, team leads, investors and multi-state agents.

### How does eXp Realty revenue share work?
eXp Realty shares a portion of company revenue with agents who attract other productive agents to the brokerage. It is paid by eXp, not taken from the other agent's commission. Program rules change over time, so Dan walks through the current plan on a call.

### Can I join ReAlto Partners if I am not in Colorado?
Yes. ReAlto is based in the Denver metro, but because eXp Realty is cloud based, agents licensed wherever eXp operates can join and take part in calls, trainings and masterminds online.

### I'm not sure what I'd bring to the team.
We believe everyone has a gift to give. If you are unsure what yours is, that is exactly what a first conversation is for.

### Does ReAlto only work with residential clients?
No. Most of our agents focus on residential sales, but through eXp Realty you also have access to a luxury brand, a commercial brokerage, a land and ranch division, investment divisions and a referral-only division.

### Is a call a commitment?
No. It is a chance to connect and get a feel for who we are. There is no obligation.

## eXp Realty

### Is ReAlto Partners a real estate brokerage?
No. eXp Realty is the brokerage and parent company. ReAlto Partners is a group of agents inside eXp Realty that adds culture, coaching, training and in-person community.

### How does eXp Realty revenue share work?
eXp Realty shares a portion of company revenue with agents who attract other productive agents to the brokerage. It is paid by eXp, not taken from the other agent's commission. Program rules change over time, so Dan or Dianne will walk you through the current details.

### Can agents own eXp stock?
Yes. eXp agents can earn stock through production, milestones and attraction, so many become shareholders in the brokerage they work in.

### Do I need to be in Colorado?
No. eXp Realty is in all 50 states and more than 30 countries, and ReAlto Partners already has agents in Texas, California, Wisconsin and Minnesota.

## The podcast

### What is The Resilient Real Estate Agent?
The Resilient Real Estate Agent is a video podcast on YouTube hosted by Dan Gomer with co-host Allison Gomer.

### Who hosts The Resilient Real Estate Agent?
Dan Gomer, co-founder of ReAlto Partners, a group within eXp Realty and a former teacher, with his wife and fellow co-founder Allison Gomer, a Realtor on the team.

### Who is the podcast for?
Real estate agents and team leaders who want to beat burnout, grow personally and build a business that lasts, plus anyone curious about the psychology of success.

### Where can I watch it?
On YouTube at @theresilientrealestateagent. Subscribe there to get new episodes.

### When do new episodes come out?
New episodes air every other Tuesday at 9 a.m. Mountain.

### How can I be a guest?
Use the guest and topic form on this page to pitch yourself, recommend a guest or suggest a topic.

## Dan Gomer

### Who is Dan Gomer?
Dan Gomer is a Colorado real estate team leader at eXp Realty and the co-founder of ReAlto Partners. He is a former middle school science teacher and basketball coach, a real estate investor and a speaker.

### What brokerage is Dan Gomer with?
Dan Gomer has been with eXp Realty since 2022. Before that he spent about ten years at Your Castle Real Estate in the Denver area.

### How did Dan Gomer get into real estate?
He started by flipping houses in Denver, then shifted his focus to helping people buy and sell homes and, later, to building a team that helps other agents grow.

### Does Dan Gomer have a podcast?
Yes. Dan hosts The Resilient Real Estate Agent on YouTube with his wife and partner, Allison Gomer. It helps agents beat burnout and build a business that lasts.

## Allison Gomer

### Who is Allison Gomer?
Allison Gomer is a Colorado Realtor and co-founder of ReAlto Partners, a group within eXp Realty, the wife of team leader Dan Gomer, and co-host of The Resilient Real Estate Agent podcast on YouTube.

### Can Allison help me buy or sell a home in Colorado?
Yes. Allison helps buyers and sellers across the Denver metro area, including Highlands Ranch and Douglas County. Reach her through the form on this page or call 303.261.5278.

### What is it like to work with Allison?
Calm, unhurried and honest. Allison listens first, keeps people steady when the stakes are high and helps families make clear decisions about where and how they want to live.

### What does Allison do at ReAlto Partners?
Alongside her own clients, Allison partners with Dan on the people side of the organization: culture, connection and helping agents take care of themselves so they can stay in the business for the long run.

### Is Allison on the podcast?
Yes. Allison co-hosts The Resilient Real Estate Agent with Dan, bringing the human side of resilience to every episode.

## Dianne Schell

### Who is Dianne Schell?
Dianne Schell is co-leader of ReAlto Partners and a Colorado Springs Realtor with eXp Realty. A REALTOR, mentor and natural connector, she leads the team's presence in Colorado Springs alongside founders Dan and Allison Gomer.

### How did Dianne get into real estate?
After 21 years as a Senior Vice President at a Fortune 20 company, Dianne left corporate leadership and found real estate, where she combines building relationships, solving problems and helping people succeed.

### How do I reach Dianne?
Book a 30-minute call on Dianne’s Calendly, or connect with her on LinkedIn, Facebook or Instagram.
